description: Implementation of QuicFrame class and related functions for handling various QUIC protocol frames in Chromium's quiche library.

classes.name: QuicFrame
classes.description: Represents different types of QUIC protocol frames with various constructors and utility functions.

methods.name: DeleteFrames
methods.description: Deletes all frames in a list, freeing associated memory.

methods.name: DeleteFrame
methods.description: Deletes a single frame based on its type, freeing allocated resources.

methods.name: IsControlFrame
methods.description: Checks if a frame type is a control frame.

methods.name: GetControlFrameId
methods.description: Retrieves the control frame ID from a frame.

methods.name: SetControlFrameId
methods.description: Sets the control frame ID for a given frame.

methods.name: CopyRetransmittableControlFrame
methods.description: Creates a copy of a retransmittable control frame.

methods.name: CopyQuicFrame
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a QUIC frame using an allocator.

methods.name: CopyQuicFrames
methods.description: Creates deep copies of a list of frames.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a textual representation of a frame to an output stream.

methods.name: QuicFrameToString
methods.description: Converts a frame to its string representation.

methods.name: QuicFramesToString
methods.description: Converts a list of frames to a concatenated string representation.
